scan_metadata.paper_name: VICReg: Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning (Bardes, Ponce, LeCun, ICLR 2022)
scan_metadata.user_filter: VICReg loss computation on user-supplied embeddings (main_vicreg.py: VICReg.forward, off_diagonal, FullGatherLayer)
scan_metadata.filter_match: path substring 'main_vicreg.py' (only in-scope source); other files read as supporting/deferred
scan_metadata.explanation: Repo has no notebooks, tests or example data. The only in-scope operation is the VICReg loss implemented in VICReg.forward (main_vicreg.py). One tool is selected: vicreg_compute_loss, which calls the upstream VICReg.forward on user embeddings by instantiating VICReg without its backbone/projector (both set to nn.Identity) inside a single-process gloo process group. Pretrained feature extraction (hubconf), linear/semi-supervised evaluation (evaluate.py) and pretraining are deferred/out of scope.

tutorials.title: VICReg pretraining script (VICReg module, loss, Projector, LARS, FullGatherLayer)
tutorials.description: Training entry point. VICReg.forward(x, y) projects two views through backbone+projector and returns sim_coeff*invariance(MSE) + std_coeff*variance(hinge on std, eps=1e-4) + cov_coeff*covariance(off-diagonal^2 / num_features) loss, after all-gathering embeddings across processes.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Matches the user filter. VICReg.forward is the sole upstream implementation of the VICReg loss and can be applied to user-supplied embeddings by replacing backbone/projector with identities; training loop itself (main, LARS, adjust_learning_rate, ImageNet loading) is out of scope.

tool_review.task_and_io: User evaluates the VICReg objective on their own paired embeddings (e.g., to monitor collapse, compare representations, or reproduce the loss). Inputs: Z, Z' float [n, d] with identical shape; sim_coeff/std_coeff/cov_coeff (source defaults 25/25/1 from get_arguments). Outputs: total loss and per-term values.

binding_plan: sys.path.insert(repo/vicreg); import main_vicreg (module import needs torch, torchvision, Pillow, numpy because it imports augmentations/resnet/torchvision.datasets; __main__ guard prevents training).

If not torch.distributed.is_initialized(): init_process_group(backend='gloo', init_method='tcp://127.0.0.1:<free port>' or file://, world_size=1, rank=0). With world_size=1 FullGatherLayer.forward returns the tensor unchanged (all_gather of one), so the gathered batch equals the local batch.

Build the module without its ResNet: m = main_vicreg.VICReg.__new__(main_vicreg.VICReg); nn.Module.__init__(m); m.args = argparse.Namespace(batch_size=n, sim_coeff=..., std_coeff=..., cov_coeff=..., mlp=str(d)); m.num_features = d; m.backbone = nn.Identity(); m.projector = nn.Identity(). (Alternative VICReg(args) would construct a full resnet (smallest available is resnet34; no resnet18) and a projector that are then discarded; bypassing __init__ is equivalent for forward since __init__ only sets args, num_features, backbone, projector.)
Call loss = m.forward(Z, Zp) under torch.no_grad() in float32 (or float64 if requested); total = loss.item().

Per-term values: forward returns only the weighted sum; obtain repr/std/cov terms by calling the same upstream forward with coefficients (1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1). No loss formula is re-implemented in the wrapper. (Loss is linear in coefficients, so total == sum coeff_i * term_i up to float rounding; this identity belongs in tests, not the wrapper.)
binding_notes: args.batch_size must equal the GLOBAL batch size = n (covariance divides by batch_size - 1); set it from Z.shape[0], never from the source default 2048.
self.num_features must equal d (source derives it from args.mlp last element).
Variance term uses unbiased x.var(dim=0) + 1e-4 epsilon and hinge target 1 (gamma=1) hard-coded upstream; not exposed as parameters.
F.mse_loss averages over n*d elements (paper Eq. uses sum over batch / n; faithful to code).
forward mutates nothing persistent; pow_ in-place applies only to temporaries.

prerequisites: torch (CPU), torchvision, Pillow, numpy importable (module-level imports of main_vicreg/augmentations)
single-process torch.distributed gloo group (FullGatherLayer calls dist.get_world_size/all_gather)
no GPU, no weights, no ImageNet needed

data_contract.Z_prime: 2-D float array, same shape as Z

verification_source.kind: small driver calling the documented upstream callable directly (no official test/example/data exists in the repo)
verification_source.inputs: Seeded synthetic embeddings, e.g. torch.manual_seed(0); Z = torch.randn(64, 32); Z' = Z + 0.1*torch.randn(64, 32); plus collapse case (Z = Z' = constant rows) and identical-inputs case (Z == Z')
comparisons: wrapper total == direct VICReg.forward(Z, Z') with default coefficients (independent upstream call)
per-term values equal direct upstream calls with one-hot coefficients; total == 25*inv + 25*var + 1*cov

property checks from code: Z == Z' gives invariance 0; constant (collapsed) embeddings give variance term = 1 - sqrt(1e-4) = 0.99 per branch, i.e. std_loss 0.99; changed coefficients change total linearly
error cases: shape mismatch, n < 2, non-2D input
